title: InvoiceFlow
subtitle: How a supplier invoice becomes a scheduled payment, with no manual typing

scenes.title: It starts with an email
scenes.caption: A supplier emails an invoice. InvoiceFlow picks it up automatically, so nobody has to forward anything.

scenes.title: Nothing gets lost
scenes.caption: The original PDF is stored safely, so there is a copy to audit later.

scenes.title: AI does the typing
scenes.caption: An AI model reads the invoice and pulls out the supplier, amounts, dates and every line item.

scenes.title: A safety check
scenes.caption: If the AI is confident, the invoice moves on. If not, a person on the finance team checks it first.

scenes.title: Only pay for what you ordered
scenes.caption: Next it is matched to the original purchase order, so you only pay for what you actually ordered.

scenes.title: Mistakes get fixed at the source
scenes.caption: Mismatches go back to the supplier, and their corrected invoice re-enters the same pipeline.

scenes.title: Done
scenes.caption: Approved invoices land in your accounting system and the payment is scheduled.

omitted.reason: internal retry when the accounting system is briefly down; no business decision

outro.caption: From inbox to payment, with a human in the loop only when it matters.
outro.cta: Every invoice, read, checked and paid automatically.
